title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garam masala, garlic, and ginger for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through.
Sauté onions until golden, add tomatoes, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add cooked chicken and cream, simmer for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice or naan.
